digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler / janitor approval phase (RP-02 through RP-06)
propositions: Five approved-but-lossy RP-02 through RP-06 decisions recovered from 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed decision-ready briefs covering architectural intent, test behavior, and implementation-critical ambiguities before becoming implementation stories.

RP-02 transaction semantics require ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with durable tombstone as retirement intent; recovery removes live forward/reverse pair only when tombstone and pair identities exactly agree; repeat is a no-op; ambiguity or failure safety-aborts.

RP-03 requires scoped finite-pass failure classification and fuse mechanics that preserve Jira's reason-qualified 429 scopes (global/tenant quota aborts, endpoint burst stops only that mutation family, per-issue Cloud 429, unknown 429 after 3 consecutive exhausted operations) and bounded idempotent containment after Jira create succeeds but key persistence fails.

RP-04 approved explicit precedence (CLI > environment > project > user > default) with per-operation snapshot, separate secret/provider boundary, and central defaults requires story to explicitly name CLI-over-environment tracker precedence correction and removal of Cloud's adapter-local fallback.

RP-06 approved effective applicability reversal, effective built-in/project-DET routing, and authored explicit budget enforcement require clarification of parity-first current-run failure projection versus normalization, with failed/cancelled/shed units never becoming success checkpoints and transient failures distinguished from zero-finding success.
